intent: Group the placeholder's media, title, description and detail line into one centered text block.
typical_uses: The block at the top of an Empty holding its icon or illustration and its explanatory text

dont_use_when.situation: A header for a card or panel that holds real content

invariants.text: EmptyHeader is a flex column that centers its children, spaces them var(--space-2) apart and caps its own width at 24rem.

anti_patterns.do_instead: Render EmptyActions as a direct child of Empty after the header, so the root's var(--space-6) gap separates the text block from the action row

good.title: Media, title and description in one header
good.code:
<EmptyHeader>
  <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
    <InboxIcon />
  </EmptyMedia>
  <EmptyTitle>No messages</EmptyTitle>
  <EmptyDescription>New messages will appear here.</EmptyDescription>
</EmptyHeader>

bad.title: The action row folded into the header
bad.why: Inside the header the actions sit var(--space-2) under the text and are held to its 24rem width; as a child of Empty they get the root's var(--space-6) gap above them.
